evidence.quote:
All interviews lasted around
60 minutes and were conducted online in English.

The
first and second authors undertook independent, line-by-line
analysis of the text and assigned codes
This resulted in 46 codes assigned to 257 pieces of text.

Data saturation was reached
at 10 interviews for the first author and 11 interviews for the
second author

the results also point that these approaches are not
always isolated from each other.

without examining how different development approaches
influence the usability of the tools.

Each of these approaches can be applied more generally in
European research and innovation.
